question: Should this PR be narrowed to loopback-focused OpenAI-compatible classification, or should photoscrawl intentionally add arbitrary model endpoints and the new export capability in the same change?
rationale: Repository policy makes private-media transmission and Photos-package handling explicit product boundaries, while this branch adds both a configurable network destination and a separate export surface without maintainer-confirmed scope.

options.title: Narrow to classifier-only
options.body: Keep LM Studio/OpenAI-compatible classification, remove the export feature from this branch, and add explicit disclosure for any non-loopback endpoint.

options.title: Approve the broader contract
options.body: Retain both capabilities only after documenting the intended remote-endpoint policy, recording transmission provenance, guarding Photos-library destinations, and supplying real behavior proof.

recommendation.title: Narrow to classifier-only
recommendation.body: Keep LM Studio/OpenAI-compatible classification, remove the export feature from this branch, and add explicit disclosure for any non-loopback endpoint.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository policy names Josh's latest direction as authoritative when provider behavior or docs conflict, and this decision defines the product's private-media boundary.
